title.narrative: Support to the National Strategy for Digital Education, Educational Transformation and Micro-Sciences

description.narrative: This initiative aims to strengthen the Ministry of Education in the design and implementation of a comprehensive national strategy for digital education and educational transformation, with an emphasis on developing competencies in micro-sciences and STEM. The project promotes a systemic, inclusive and forward-looking approach that integrates pedagogical innovation, teacher training and institutional strengthening, in alignment with national priorities and UNESCO global frameworks.
